name: Spaghetti Bolognese
method: Soften the chopped onion, carrot and garlic in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown it, breaking it up.
Stir in the tomato purée, then the chopped tomatoes. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, drain, and serve with the sauce and grated cheddar.

name: Chicken Curry with Rice
method: Fry the chopped onion and garlic for 5 minutes, then add the diced chicken and brown.
Stir in the curry paste, then the chopped tomatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice. Warm the naan in the oven.
Take the curry off the heat, stir in the yoghurt and serve.

name: Shepherd's Pie
method: Boil the peeled, chopped potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with the butter and milk.
Meanwhile brown the lamb mince with the chopped onion and carrot.
Add the crumbled stock cube, a splash of water and the peas. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon into a dish, top with mash and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

name: Sausage and Mash
method: Grill or oven-cook the sausages for 20 to 25 minutes.
Boil the peeled, chopped potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with butter and milk.
Fry the sliced onions slowly until soft and make up the gravy.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes and serve everything together.

name: Chilli con Carne
method: Fry the chopped onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes, then brown the mince.
Add the chilli powder, chopped tomatoes and drained kidney beans. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Serve with soured cream.

name: Salmon, New Potatoes and Greens
method: Boil the new potatoes for 15 to 20 minutes.
Season the salmon and bake at 200°C for 12 to 15 minutes, with a slice of lemon on top.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Toss the potatoes in butter and serve.

name: Veggie Noodle Stir-fry
method: Cook the noodles as the packet says and drain.
Stir-fry the garlic, sliced pepper and vegetables on a high heat for 4 minutes.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs in the pan, then mix everything together.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, toss for 2 minutes and serve.

name: Jacket Potatoes with Beans and Cheese
method: Prick the potatoes and microwave for 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway (or bake at 200°C for an hour).
Heat the beans.
Split the potatoes, add butter, beans and grated cheddar.
Serve with salad leaves.

name: Roast Chicken Dinner
method: Roast the chicken at 190°C for 20 minutes per 500g plus 20 minutes.
Parboil the peeled potatoes for 10 minutes, shake them up, then roast in hot oil for 45 minutes.
Boil the carrots and broccoli for the last 10 minutes and cook the Yorkshire puddings as the packet says.
Rest the chicken for 15 minutes, make the gravy and carve.

name: Macaroni Cheese
method: Cook the macaroni and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk a little at a time until thick.
Stir in most of the cheese, then the macaroni. Pour into a dish.
Top with sliced tomatoes and the rest of the cheese. Grill or bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.

name: Chicken Fajitas
method: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion and toss with the seasoning.
Fry on a high heat for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the wraps for 20 seconds in the microwave.
Serve with soured cream, grated cheese and salsa so everyone builds their own.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry
method: Flatten the chicken, dip in flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Shallow fry for 4 to 5 minutes each side until golden, or bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Cook the rice and warm the katsu sauce.
Slice the chicken, pour over the sauce and serve with rice and sliced cucumber.

name: Beef Burgers and Wedges
method: Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss in oil and roast at 220°C for 30 minutes.
Season the mince, shape into 4 burgers and fry or grill for 5 minutes each side.
Top each burger with cheese for the last minute.
Serve in buns with sliced tomato, onion and salad.

name: Creamy Chicken and Bacon Pasta
method: Cook the penne.
Fry the chopped bacon until crisp, then add the diced chicken and garlic and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cream and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
method: Toss the diced chicken in cornflour and fry until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add the chopped pepper and onion and fry for 3 minutes.
Stir in the drained pineapple and the sauce and bubble for 5 minutes.
Serve with rice.

name: Fish Finger Wraps
method: Grill or oven-cook the fish fingers for 12 to 15 minutes.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes.
Warm the wraps.
Fill the wraps with fish fingers, salad, tartare sauce and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Sausage Traybake
method: Halve the potatoes and chop the veg into chunks. Toss everything with oil on a large tray.
Nestle in the sausages and roast at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Mix the honey and mustard, drizzle over, and roast for 10 more minutes.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
method: Marinate the diced chicken in yoghurt and half the paste for 10 minutes, then grill or fry until charred.
Fry the onion and garlic, add the rest of the paste and the tomatoes, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve with rice and warm naan.

name: Lasagne
method: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic, add the tomatoes and purée and simmer for 20 minutes.
Layer mince, lasagne sheets and white sauce in a dish, finishing with sauce and grated cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes.
Serve with salad.

name: Pesto Pasta with Chicken
method: Cook the fusilli.
Fry the diced chicken for 8 minutes until cooked.
Add the halved tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Toss everything with the pesto, parmesan and pine nuts.

name: Tuna Pasta Bake
method: Cook the penne and drain.
Soften the chopped onion, then mix with the pasta, drained tuna, sweetcorn and white sauce.
Tip into a dish, top with cheese and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

name: Chicken and Chorizo Jambalaya
method: Fry the sliced chorizo until the oil runs, then brown the diced chicken.
Add the onion, pepper, garlic and Cajun seasoning and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes and 600ml stock. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is tender.

name: Toad in the Hole
method: Brown the sausages in a roasting tin with 2 tbsp oil at 220°C for 10 minutes.
Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Pour the batter around the hot sausages and bake for 30 minutes without opening the door.
Boil the carrots and peas and make up the gravy.

name: Prawn Stir-fry with Rice
method: Cook the rice.
Fry the garlic and grated ginger for 30 seconds, add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry on a high heat for 4 minutes.
Add the soy and sweet chilli sauce, toss and serve with rice.

name: Cottage Pie
method: Boil the peeled, chopped potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with the butter and milk.
Brown the mince with the onion and carrot, add the purée, crumbled stock cube and 300ml water. Simmer 15 minutes, then stir in the peas.
Top with mash and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
method: Mix the honey, crushed garlic and soy sauce and coat the thighs.
Roast at 200°C for 35 to 40 minutes, basting once.
Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.
Spoon the sticky juices over the chicken to serve.

name: Halloumi and Veg Traybake
method: Chop the veg into chunks, toss with oil and herbs and roast at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Add the sliced halloumi and roast for 10 more minutes until golden.
Make the couscous with boiling water and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve the traybake over the couscous.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
method: Bring 1.2 litres of stock to the boil with the diced carrot.
Add the diced chicken and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the noodles and sweetcorn and cook for 4 minutes.
Finish with soy sauce and sliced spring onions.

name: Quesadillas and Salad
method: Mix the grated cheese, drained beans, sweetcorn and sliced spring onions.
Spread over half of each wrap, fold over and fry in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and salad.

name: Slow-cooker Beef Stew
method: Toss the beef in flour and brown in batches (or skip if short of time).
Put everything except the bread in the slow cooker with 600ml stock. Cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4.
Serve with crusty bread. The 30 minutes is hands-on time.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Noodles
method: Brush the salmon with half the teriyaki and bake at 200°C for 12 minutes.
Cook the noodles, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Toss the noodles with the rest of the sauce.
Top with the salmon, spring onions and sesame seeds.

name: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
method: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and seasoning and roll into 16 meatballs. Brown in a pan.
Fry the onion and garlic, add the tomatoes and meatballs, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with parmesan.

name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
method: Fry the paste for 1 minute, add the sliced chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, add the pepper and beans, and simmer for 12 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Finish with a squeeze of lime.

name: Baked Potato Skins with Chilli
method: Microwave the potatoes for 10 minutes, then crisp in the oven at 200°C for 15.
Brown the mince and onion, add the chilli powder, tomatoes and beans, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Split the potatoes, pile on the chilli, top with cheese and soured cream.

name: Pork Schnitzel with Potato Salad
method: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, cool slightly, then mix with mayonnaise and sliced spring onions.
Bash the pork thin, coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry for 3 to 4 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with the potato salad and lemon wedges.

name: Veggie Chilli
method: Fry the onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes, add the chilli powder.
Add the drained beans, sweetcorn and tomatoes and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with rice and soured cream.

name: Chicken Caesar Wraps
method: Fry the bacon until crisp and the sliced chicken for 8 minutes.
Shred the lettuce and toss with dressing and parmesan.
Fill the wraps with everything and roll up.

name: Pizza Night
method: Spread passata over the bases and scatter with herbs.
Top with torn mozzarella and whichever toppings each person wants.
Bake at 220°C for 12 to 15 minutes. Serve with salad.

name: Chicken and Leek Pie
method: Fry the sliced leeks and diced chicken for 8 minutes. Stir in the flour, then 200ml stock and the cream. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Tip into a pie dish, top with pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Serve with mash and peas.

name: Egg Fried Rice with Veg
method: Cook the rice (or use leftover cold rice, which works best).
Scramble the eggs in a large pan and set aside.
Fry the garlic, peas and sweetcorn for 2 minutes, add the rice and soy sauce and fry on a high heat for 4 minutes.
Stir the egg back in with the spring onions.
